title: IV fluid tonicity

findings.where: Images 1, 2, 8 and 9: intro definition; tonicity.jsx: Frame.desc
findings.title: Effective solutes are described as absolutely unable to enter cells
findings.problem: The visible definition says "cannot cross into the cell," whereas step "isotonic" correctly says "can't freely cross ... in that time." Effective osmoles need not be absolutely membrane-impermeant; what matters is whether they rapidly equilibrate across the membrane on the relevant timescale.
findings.fix: Use the qualified definition consistently in the heading and overview description: effective solutes do not freely equilibrate across the cell membrane on the relevant timescale. Wrap the heading rather than shrinking it.

assessment: One minor definition inconsistency remains; no clinical blocker identified.
